independence.interpretation: Builder strategy-seed repetitions are consistency controls because deterministic reward/target policies do not consume reward RNG; not48 independent game seeds or new build diversity. Random policy variants share16 environment seeds and are correlated; do not pool them as48 independent environments.

boundaries: Small16environment-seed sample per fixed policy/layout; warnings retained.
All durations are player-side combat seconds; human reward decisions and wall-clock time are excluded.
Builder strategy-seed repetitions are consistency controls; no independence or diversity inflation.
No human or physical-device long-session proof.
